checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan and failing-first regression tests for verified live defects

impact_assessment.why: The genuine full re-read of all 9 reforge stages surfaced 41+ real defects that the original snippet-based review missed; several are still live in current code and mislead users (wrong months, false fee/rent figures, incomplete clear-all, saved language ignored, swallowed backup failures).
impact_assessment.benefits: Correct user-facing financial figures and reliable core behaviours; restore trust in the reforge audit; leave durable failing-first tests.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: exported function signatures must stay stable; dependency: none new; concurrency: none; state: clear-all and storage paths touch persisted state
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep signatures unchanged, add tests in the existing node:test harness, change only verified defect sites, run full npm test and check --strict before commit
